caption: A basketball shot from the three-point line drops through the hoop.

sa.check: A basketball is shot from behind the three-point line.
It goes cleanly through rather than bouncing on the rim first.

pc.expect: The ball follows one smooth arc that rises, peaks and descends into the hoop.
pc.fail: The ball flies flat at a constant height; or it hangs above the rim; or it changes direction in mid-flight with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: After the peak the ball comes down, passes through the hoop, and continues down toward the floor.
pc.fail: The ball rises again after starting to fall; or it stops in the net and stays there; or it floats back up out of the hoop.

pc.expect: The net swings and flares as the ball passes through, and the ball keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The net stays rigid and still as the ball passes through it; or the ball squashes to fit and stays squashed; or the net closes and holds the ball like a bag.

pc.expect: The ball passes through the open ring and the net, not through the rim's metal or the backboard.
pc.fail: The ball passes through the metal of the rim; or it passes through the backboard; or the net passes through the ball.

pc.expect: One ball and one hoop are there throughout.
pc.fail: The ball vanishes in flight or a second one appears; or the ball turns into another object; or the hoop disappears from the backboard.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and seams, the court markings and the backboard stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour in flight; or the three-point line shifts between frames; or the backboard changes shape.
